no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-crosswordgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Crossword Generator is a crossword puzzle API that creates crosswords with intersecting words, numbered clues, and themed word selection.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-csvtojsonconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: CSV to JSON Converter parses raw CSV text into an array of JSON objects with column names and row counts. It handles comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe delimiters, with optional header row detection.

no_pyproject_toml.name: auditail
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Controls and evidence for AI agents that move money: spending limits, human approval, a kill switch and a signed, tamper-evident audit log.

no_pyproject_toml.name: numind
no_pyproject_toml.summary: SDK to interact with the NuMind models API.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-currencyrate
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Currency Rate returns one currency's live value in US dollars or any other base, across 170+ currencies, with its name, symbol and direction since yesterday. Paid plans add any base currency, 1-day to 1-year changes, 24-hour and 30-day highs and lows, and hourly and 30-day daily history.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countryflags
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Flags is a country flag API that fetches direct download URLs for national flag images using two-letter ISO country codes. Responses return the country name, ISO code, and image link, while paid plans can select SVG or PNG formats and shapes.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countydatalookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: County Data Lookup is a county lookup API that retrieves income, poverty rate, and life expectancy for any US county by state and county name, along with its FIPS code and time zone. Paid plans add age demographics, educational attainment, health indicators, ZIP codes, and cost of living.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cronexpressiongenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cron Expression Generator converts natural language schedule text into standard five-field cron expressions. Submit phrases up to 200 characters to receive the matching cron syntax, with paid plans adding written explanations.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cpiinflation
no_pyproject_toml.summary: CPI Inflation provides monthly Consumer Price Index data broken down by category including food, housing, transportation, medical care, and more. Includes year-over-year and month-over-month inflation rates for each category, with three-month changes on paid plans.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countrylanguages
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Languages lists official and commonly spoken languages for any country using its two-letter ISO code. It returns the common country name, formal official name, an array of recognized languages, and the total language count.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cloudcounter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cloud Counter stores and updates persistent numeric counters by ID without needing a database. It tracks increments, decrements, and custom values while returning timestamps and number properties like parity and prime status.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-contentfilter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Content Filter checks URLs against a comprehensive blocklist of 200,000+ domains categorized as ads-malware, fake news, gambling, adult content, or social media. Returns the specific category for blocked domains, plus every category a domain appears in across a 1.7M-domain index.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-coordinatesaresea
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Coordinates Are Sea checks whether a given latitude and longitude pair sits in the ocean or on land. Pass geographic coordinates to receive a boolean confirming if the location is in the sea.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-costofliving
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cost of Living is a cost of living API that returns price-level indices for US states and metropolitan areas, with the US average at 100. Compare the relative cost of living between two states or cities and calculate salary equivalents for relocation decisions on paid plans.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countryborders
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Borders identifies adjacent nations by two-letter ISO country code. It returns the list of bordering countries along with region, subregion, and landlocked status.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countrylookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Lookup matches any country name or ISO code to its official names, ISO 3166 codes, capitals, region, languages, and flag emoji. Paid plans add coordinates and major cities, and with details=true demonyms, land area and UN membership.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-contactextractor
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Contact Extractor scrapes public email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses from any web page URL. It tallies the findings and returns unique records found on the page.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-countryboundaries
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Country Boundaries retrieves GeoJSON border outlines for any country by its two-letter ISO code. Each response includes the country name, geometry type, and boundary coordinate pairs ready for mapping layers.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-commentgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Comment Generator produces social media comments formatted for text or image posts across positive, negative, and neutral tones. Each request returns generated comment text with optional emoji support, while paid plans can request batches up to 10.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-companynamegenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Company Name Generator generates business name ideas from a seed keyword, returning a list of suggested brand names. Supply any industry or concept word to receive ready-made brand naming suggestions.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-colorpalettegenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Color Palette Generator is a color palette API that builds a harmonious color scheme from one HEX base color. Every plan returns each color's HEX code, closest color name, a dark flag and a legible black or white text color; paid plans add RGB, HSL, WCAG contrast checks, CSS variables and a PNG of the palette.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-colorconverter
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Color Converter translates color values across hex, RGB, CMYK, and named inputs into standard RGB formats and channel breakdowns. Paid plans expand output to include CMYK, HSL, ANSI 16-color codes, and recognized English color names.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-colorsimilaritycalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Color Similarity Calculator measures color similarity between two hex values. It returns an overall similarity score, a categorical match rating, and RGB and HSL channel breakdowns, while paid plans add Delta E and color distance metrics.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-complimentgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Compliment Generator creates unique, heartfelt compliments using template-based generation with extensive word banks. Perfect for apps, chatbots, or spreading positivity.

no_pyproject_toml.name: openmates
no_pyproject_toml.summary: OpenMates Python SDK

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-companylookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Company Lookup matches stock tickers, CIK numbers, company names, or SIC codes with official SEC registration records. It returns legal entity names, trading exchanges, tax EINs, Standard Industrial Classification codes, and registered business addresses.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-colornamefinder
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Color Name Finder matches any hex color code to its closest named CSS color. Send a hex value to get the matching color name, RGB coordinates, and an exact match flag.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-coinflipper
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Coin Flipper simulates random coin flips and records heads or tails outcomes with flip counts. Paid plans can simulate multiple flips per request and calculate percentages, streak lengths, and fairness indicators.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-colorbrightnesscalculator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Color Brightness Calculator checks hex color brightness to classify values as light, dark, or medium, returning RGB components. Paid plans add WCAG contrast ratios, luminance scores, and recommended text colors.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-citieslookup
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cities Lookup is a city search API that searches about 135,000 cities worldwide by name to find country codes, population counts and city size classifications, with an optional country filter. Paid plans add region codes, capital status, GeoJSON coordinates and up to 20 matches per search.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cocktailrecipe
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Cocktail Recipe retrieves cocktail recipes by drink name or ingredient, providing measured ingredients, preparation instructions, and recommended glassware. Responses include serving categories and ingredient counts, with support for pulling random drinks.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-codedetector
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Code Detector identifies the programming language of any submitted code snippet. It returns the canonical language name, readable title, and standard file extension for the detected code.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chucknorrisjokes
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chuck Norris Jokes delivers a random Chuck Norris joke on every request without requiring any query parameters. Each call returns plain joke text ready to display in bots, command-line interfaces, or entertainment feeds.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chinesezodiac
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chinese Zodiac returns the zodiac animal, element, and characteristics for any birth date. Accurately accounts for the Chinese lunar calendar - the zodiac year starts on Chinese New Year, not January 1st.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chessmovevalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chess Move Validator verifies algebraic chess notation and identifies move types including castling, captures, checks, and promotions.

no_pyproject_toml.name: mihrab-methods
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Accurate, offline Islamic prayer times: the calculation methods of national Islamic authorities (Diyanet, Sweden, Morocco, Indonesia, Egypt and more), each reproducing its published timetable to the minute. No dependencies.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-charadesgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Charades Generator provides random words from curated categories perfect for playing the classic charades acting game.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-cardvalidator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Card Validator is a credit card number validator API: it checks whether a card number is valid, identifies the card brand, and flags risk. It runs the Luhn checksum, detects the scheme (Visa, Mastercard, Amex and more), returns the PCI-safe BIN and last 4 digits, flags known processor test cards, and returns a composite risk score.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-chartgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Chart Generator is a chart API that turns your data into chart and graph images. Supports bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, polar area, scatter and bubble charts with customizable styling.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-uscarmodels
no_pyproject_toml.summary: US Car Models is a car make and model API for vehicles sold in the United States from 1984 to present. List models by make on any plan, while paid plans add year filters, trims, fuel economy (MPG), engine details, and transmission specifications.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-testcardgenerator
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Test Card Generator is a test credit card generator API: it creates card numbers that pass format and Luhn checksum validation, for testing checkout forms and payment UIs across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, JCB, Diners Club and UnionPay. They aren't real cards: no bank issued them, and they can't be charged or used to buy anything. Each card comes with a security code, expiration date, issuer and masked number, and the gateway option returns Stripe's or Braintree's own documented test cards instead.

no_pyproject_toml.name: content-gateway-client
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Typed client for content-gateway: the gateway's own routes from its OpenAPI document and the CurseForge and Modrinth passthroughs with the budget's refusals handled.

no_pyproject_toml.name: apiverve-birthstones
no_pyproject_toml.summary: Birthstones is a comprehensive lookup API for birthstone information. It returns detailed data about gemstones associated with each birth month, including the primary stone, alternate stones, colors, meanings, and zodiac associations.
